Dobrovelychkivka Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Kirovohrad Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Dobrovelychkivka's Jewish population reached 1,718 (more than half the town) by 1897, supported by two prayer houses and a school for 115 students; a Yiddish school operated from the early 1920s. By 1939, only 366 Jews remained; no Jews survived the German occupation, from August 1941 to the town's liberation in March 1944. According to an employee of the local museum, this cemetery was founded in the early 19th century, though its earliest surviving tombstone dates only to 1900.
